design.title: Same eyes, more worldly upbringing: each member's EfficientNet-B0 trunk carries Noisy Student weights (semi-supervised on 300M photographs with injected noise, Apache-2.0) instead of plain ImageNet weights — identical architecture, identical size
design.init_strategy: pretrained:tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Noisy Student, Apache-2.0, ported into torchvision's EfficientNet-B0 layout with TF-same padding)
design.eli5: The drone's 'eyes' are a pair of image-recognition networks that were first taught on a big collection of everyday photos before we teach them Berlin. Every time we gave them better schooling, they got much better at recognising Berlin in a photograph they had never seen. We can't make the eyes bigger any more (the chip has no room), so this time we keep exactly the same eyes but swap in a version that was schooled on 300 million photos, deliberately shown blurred, noisy, re-coloured versions as it learned. That upbringing is known to make it far less thrown by changes in lighting and image quality — which is much of what changes between two aerial surveys of the same city.
design.hypothesis: On this ruler, every large step on the never-seen truedop_2024 photograph came from WHAT THE TRUNK BROUGHT WITH IT, not from what it learned from three Berlin surveys: from-scratch -> ImageNet MobileNetV3-Small 10.75% -> 49.5% usable (exp 12), MobileNetV2 86.75% (exp 16), EfficientNet-B0 92.5% (exp 19). Since then the training-procedure levers have given at most half a point (exp 20 weight averaging, 93.0% usable / 0.75% false / 6.25% abstain, mission 0.0777, kept) or lost ground (exp 22 continuous vantages 0.103, exp 23 cross-survey JS consistency 0.090, both reverted; exp 18 ring pooling flat). The three training photographs sit at 100% usable at the same held-out viewpoints, so the residual is purely the survey gap, and the invariance that closes it has so far come from pretraining. The obvious next trunk step is closed by the size gate: two EfficientNet-B0 members already weigh 31.7 MB of 33.6 MB. So this experiment changes the trunk's KNOWLEDGE without changing its SIZE: the same EfficientNet-B0 architecture, but initialised from the Noisy Student checkpoint (Xie et al., CVPR 2020: student trained on ImageNet + 300M pseudo-labelled JFT images under RandAugment, dropout and stochastic depth noise). The paper's headline finding is precisely out-of-distribution robustness beyond what in-domain accuracy predicts — large gains on ImageNet-C (corruptions: blur, noise, brightness, contrast, weather), ImageNet-P and ImageNet-A — and those corruption families are the photometric part of a survey change (exposure, colour balance, haze, sharpness), while 300M diverse photographs give a broader texture/structure prior than 1.3M. In-domain the B0 student is also ~1 point better (78.8 vs 77.7 top-1). This is 'better borrowed eyes' (exps 12/16/19, all kept) taken along the one axis the size gate leaves open: training data and noise of the pretraining, not parameter count. Nothing in this era or the 83 earlier experiments ever varied the pretraining SOURCE of a fixed architecture; every pretrained trunk has been torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1. Builds on experiment 20 (the champion) with everything else — resize, read levels, lifts, MixStyle, cosine head, committee, decode, losses, augmentation, schedule, weight averaging + BN recalibration — unchanged.
